scope: Actual local shared test server, SQLite and independent browser sessions. No live StoreHouse connection.
checks: The selectable PDF catalog keeps printed codes, names, groups and units distinct; 134 and 187 Bazsalikom are separate and 521 Pepsi is searchable. Quantities remain synthetic, external IDs unbound.
A reviewed multi-tablet issue has one source deduction and one receiver addition, with distinct named actors and server timestamps. Review alone has no stock effect.
Restarting the server and reloading the browser preserve stock, audit history, sessions and the manager draft; the receiver cannot see that personal draft.
A stale form from another tablet is rejected without overwriting the newer work or losing the entered quantities.
A pending issue can be cancelled only with the physical-source check and a reason; the reservation returns once, the original record remains and no waste is fabricated.
An intentionally lost reply leaves an explicitly uncertain command; checking its persisted result recovers the accepted move without another stock write.
Changing the assigned receiver and deputy preserves the pending transfer and all stock, while recording the previous and new named responsibility.

A closed issue is corrected by a separately reviewed and confirmed return linked to its original record; the original quantities and timestamps are unchanged, and only the compensating quantity moves.
An opened bar shift remains visibly accountable. A manager can interrupt a started count with a reason, release its movement pause and preserve stock without inventing a correction.

A cancelled count can be started again, submitted by the assigned receiver and explicitly closed by the manager. Submitted counts do not silently adjust stock; the shift changes from open through counting and submitted to closed.
Closed and cancelled moves remain reachable from the personal audit trail with original timing and quantities.
Two devices editing the same personal draft retain both versions and require an explicit server/device choice. Choosing the saved version restores its quantity without a stock command.
